location.title: Location
location.intro: Nestled in the heart of Antioquia, just two hours from Medellín, Guatapé is Colombia's most colorful village — a living canvas of vibrant houses, charming zócalos, and breathtaking lake views. Set on the shores of the Peñol-Guatapé Reservoir and only 10 km from the towering Piedra del Peñol, this picturesque town offers endless adventures, from kayaking and wake surfing to climbing the famous 700 steps for panoramic mountain vistas. After a day of exploring, unwind with authentic Antioquian flavors and tropical cocktails as the sun sets over the water.
location.roadWarning: The road may not be suitable for every car. Vehicles should have higher clearance or be 4x4 to pass.

hotels.title: Hotel Options
hotels.subtitle: Here are a few options you might consider. Of course, you can also explore other nearby places close to the venue that better match your taste or budget — there are many options available.

cristalinaCabana.name: Cristalina Cabana
cristalinaCabana.description: A spacious 4-bedroom villa with modern amenities, private garden, BBQ area, and breathtaking lake, mountain, and landmark views for a relaxed and scenic stay by the reservoir.

hotel2.name: Moon Inn
hotel2.description: A cozy inn with comfortable rooms and a friendly atmosphere, perfect for a stay close to the event.

hotel3.name: Stars Guesthouse
hotel3.description: A charming guesthouse with simple rooms, breakfast included, and a homely feel.

guatapeViajero.name: Guatape Viajero
guatapeViajero.description: very close by the event venue, picturesque, and amazing. No kids allowed.

monteGandolfo.name: Monte Gandolfo
monteGandolfo.description: Apartamentos Monte Gandolfo is located in Guatapé, about 8.7 km from Piedra del Peñol. It offers free Wi‑Fi, a garden with a terrace, and access to a shared hot tub. Some units also include a kitchenette for self-catering.
monteGandolfo.hint: Quiet, scenic spot — consider arranging transport as it’s a short drive from town.

viajeroHostal.name: Viajero Hostal
viajeroHostal.description: Viajero Hostal in Guatapé overlooks the lake and offers a relaxed, social atmosphere. The communal areas are perfect for meeting fellow travelers, and the hostel is close to restaurants and local transport. For discounts, book in advance via their promotions page.
viajeroHostal.hint: Book in advance for this discount.

altoLunaGlamping.name: Alto Luna Glamping
altoLunaGlamping.description: Luna Nueva is a private cabin located in El Peñol, offering a unique experience of connection with nature and comfort. Surrounded by mountains and overlooking the reservoir, this cabin is the perfect place to disconnect from the urban bustle and immerse yourself in the tranquility of the Antioquia landscape. Enjoy panoramic views of the Peñol rock, the Guatapé reservoir and the replica of the old Peñol.
altoLunaGlamping.hint: Remote cabin experience; limited facilities and booking fills up fast — consider reserving early.

story.title: Our Story
story.subtitle: Once upon a time, Chris went to Colombia while Maria was living in Australia. Few years later Chris left Europe to visit Australia in the exact moment when Maria left Australia to travel in Europe (great timing, universe 👏)
story.paragraph2: Maria went to a salsa festival in Croatia looking for a soulmate. And she did find one… it was Caro. Instant best friend! Together they went to the festival three years in a row. In the fourth year Caro skipped the salsa and went to another event with her "good friend" (spoiler: that was Chris 👀).
story.paragraph3: Maria kept traveling and eventually landed at a digital nomad festival in Bulgaria. Caro messaged her: "my "good friend" is there, you should meet him!" …but never shared his contact (thanks, Caro). The universe clearly had a plan. That same weekend, Maria and Chris bumped into each other while trying to escape a busy and noisy party. They started talking, lost track of time, and didn't notice everyone else had already left.
story.paragraph4: The next morning, Maria went for a 7am run. Chris went to the park to work out. They crossed paths again… and from that moment, they never separated.
story.paragraph5: In their first year, they traveled through 14 countries together. Proof that one conversation can turn into a whole adventure. What began as "just one conversation" turned into love, adventure, and now this wedding that we are looking forward to celebrating together. 🎉💍
